name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Both Zwischenzug goes with Garry and the player known for the Arabian mate does not belong to the King's-Pawn Camp if and only if Scholar's goes with Mikhail.
Italian goes with exactly two of Nadia, Zwischenzug, and Scholar's.
Garry goes with Damiano's if and only if either Mikhail does not go with Fork or Benoni goes with Zwischenzug (but not both).
At least one of (the members of the King's-Pawn Camp and the player known for the Scholar's mate) belongs to the Evening Study Group.
Exactly two of (the members of the Queen's-Pawn Camp, the player who loves the Fork, and the player who loves the Discovery) go with (Damiano's or Scholar's).
Damiano's goes with exactly two of Vera, Benoni, and Fork.
Discovery, Gambit, and Zwischenzug go with Mikhail, Benoni, and Italian, in some order.
Between Zwischenzug and Boden's, one goes with Benoni and the other with French.
